dedupe_keys.name: indicateur annualise gaz renouvelable des territoires par epci

description: Indicateur Annualisé Gaz Renouvelable des territoires par epci is a dataset listed in Open Data Réseaux Énergies (ODRÉ), a shared open data portal of the French energy network operators, published or maintained by RTE, GRTgaz, Teréga, Enedis, GRDF and other French network operators (ODRÉ). Ce jeu de données présente les valeurs du ratio entre la production locale de gaz renouvelable et la consommation locale de gaz sur le périmètre EPCI. Pour calculer ce ratio: • La quantité de gaz renouvelable produite les 3 derniers mois sur le territoire est annualisée grâce à une multiplication par quatre. Coverage: France. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Production, Consommation, Territoires et régions. Its keywords are IGR, EnR, Biogaz. The portal shows 2021-04-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odre-open-data-portal.
